capture_method: OneROM live substitution; checksum-protected RBCP; verified restoration

observation_profile.phases: NOP bit0 (+2 CCK), EXG bit1 (+3 CCK); conditional branch costs also apply; recorded brackets are authoritative
observation_profile.event_offset: CIA Timer-A latch32+offset E clocks; Copper WAIT line66 h60+2*offset CCK
observation_profile.watchdog: Copper SOFT level1 at line70 h60; all ordinary handlers disable all sources
observation_profile.units: raw VHPOSR words, register flags, absolute stacked PC; no alignment or packed-beam subtraction
observation_profile.launch: Same launch/strobe/write opcodes; observer selected before ROM alignment; exact launch qualification.
observation_profile.limitations: Software ordering and status witnesses, not electrical edges. WAIT may restart at VBL; entry COPER must be confirmed before launch.
observation_profile.variants: bit0 priority;bit3 inert start;bit4 unused-neighbor write;bits6:5 NOP0..3;bits9:8 Copper0=off,1=settledWAIT,2=active
observation_profile.hypothesis: Startup source-fetch progress depends on Copper state, separately from CPU status observation.
observation_profile.competitor: Source ordering is unchanged; differences belong to CPU read arbitration/visibility.

repeatability.note: Zero conflicts does not establish cross-run repeatability when phase cohorts do not overlap.

uncontrolled_state: PAL A500 stock68000,512KiB chip/512KiB slow; silicon revisions unconfirmed. Reuse operator-confirmed clean power session after128-case control passed twice. Live substitution with verified restoration; software observations,no electrical edge claims.
